## Functional summary

This 591-amino-acid protein is **2-succinyl-5-enolpyruvyl-6-hydroxy-3-cyclohexene-1-carboxylate synthase** (also called **MenD**, EC 2.2.1.9). The sequence is an **exact full-length match** to reviewed UniProt entry **B7K0T5** from *Rippkaea orientalis*, making this assignment stronger than a prediction based only on general sequence similarity. Its Pfam hits to TPP-enzyme domains are also consistent with the annotation.

The enzyme uses **thiamine diphosphate (TPP)** and a divalent metal ion (**Mg²⁺ or Mn²⁺**). It catalyzes the TPP-dependent reaction of **2-oxoglutarate and isochorismate** to produce **SEPHCHC**, an intermediate in **1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoate and phylloquinone (vitamin K₁) biosynthesis**. The reference record also carries a GO association with menaquinone biosynthesis; its explicitly listed pathway annotation emphasizes phylloquinone/1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoate biosynthesis.
